answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before earning reputation, like water rights at a desert oasis: one identity, one deposit, backed by linked work history. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake account separately, so raising a plume of sock puppets multiplies locked capital and slashing risk, while honest agents recover their stake through useful work. Forged identities become expensive, slow to build, and easy to burn; no ivory credential can be copied cheaply across many accounts.
